messages:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] Hosted API queue growth detected in region g-west-3. GPU pool g-west-3-a mem 98%. Request backlog +14x in last 6m. P95/P99 latency spike. Triggered autoscale attempt -> failed (rate-limited). Paging alice-oncall @here

alice-oncall: I'm on it. Looking at dashboards now, switching to high-noise filter. Allocations show a lot of long-lived KV caches for chat sessions.

ben-eng: autoscaler logs show repeated 429 from cloud provider. Provisioner: "QuotaExceeded: API rate limit". New nodes not being created. digging into retry backoff.

carla-sre: if autoscaler blocked we should manually trigger a scale to make space for queued requests. Do we have available spare pools in eu-west? also check node image boot times.

dave-prod: customer-impact: 3 customers on Hosted tier reporting timeouts / 504s. Support ticket IDs: #8762, #8769. p99 token latency -> 12s -> 45s in last 10m.

eve-support: confirming, two enterprise customers seeing 5-15% error rate on generation endpoint. They're on region g-west-3.

ben-eng: trying a manual API create now. Command:
```
./provisioner create-pool --region g-west-3 --size 4 --instance-type p4d --priority emergency
```
Getting 429s for create-pool calls, provider response: rate limit window open for 2m.

infra-bot: provider-rate-limit: window reset in ~110s. Current create attempts: 6 queued.

alice-oncall: immediate mitigation plan:
- enable routed fallback to eu-west for non-low-latency customers
- apply temporary per-api-key rate limits for bursty customers
- bump fallback-model to quantized variant for priority customers
- open a provider support ticket for rate-limit exemption

ben-eng: implementing fallback routing rule now: route customers flagged `can-tolerate-region` -> eu-west.

carla-sre: also turning off chunked/batch prefetch for long-running chats to free KV memory: patch:
```
PATCH /runtime/config
- batching.enabled = true
+ batching.enabled = false
```
Rolling to 10% canary.

dave-prod: pushing a note to the affected customers about degraded perf + mitigation steps. Let me know if we need to apply credits.

eve-support: done, customers are aware. asking for ETA.

ben-eng: manual scale attempts failed until rate-limit window clears. Fallback routing now active for ~30% of traffic, backlog decreasing but p99 still elevated.

alice-oncall: switching to handoff: ben-eng will own next 45m while I get rest. Ben, please escalate to infra on-call if provider doesn't clear. Ops lead cc'd.

ben-eng: ack, taking over. Current snapshot: backlog ~3.2k reqs (was 8.9k), p95 3.1s, p99 18.7s. Continuing to monitor.

infra-bot: incident created INC-20260317-9412345678. Paging infra on-call.

carla-sre: follow-up actions logged in runbook: reduce-batching, fallback-route, open provider-exemption. schedule postmortem for tomorrow.

alice-oncall: thanks team. leaving channel but available by DM. :thumbsup:

ben-eng: will update in 15m or on notable change. handing to night-sre if escalates.
